description:
Burdened by trauma from his stepbrother’s obsessive behavior, Byeo-ru is introduced to Jung Joo-in, a senior from another department at university. Although his first impression of Joo-in isn’t great, Byeo-ru gradually finds himself drawn to his easygoing personality. However, Joo-in has long been harboring feelings for someone else…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_samedream_wz), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10637148), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/ideal_dream)
